Maya Patel: Heads up — during Precursor onboarding we saw p95 tail latency spike on /generate starting 2026-03-15 14:04 UTC. Root cause looks like long instruction inputs + small batch sizes. Proposing a proactive recommendation: enable compact model (gptx-compact-int8) for high-throughput routes and use split routing: short/medium sequences -> compact-int8, long sequences -> full-precision base model; fall back to base if quality regresses. Canary 5% traffic for 24h.
Jordan Lee: SGTM. Metrics: p95 went from 420ms -> 980ms on peak, tokens/sec dropped 30%. Do we have eval delta for compact model? Also suggest prefix caching and 2s batching window.
Maya Patel: Eval on Precursor dev prompts shows median quality drop ~0.6% BLEU-like metric, hallucination unchanged. We tested prefix cache + kv cache hit 12% -> est 18% cost saving. Canary config (example):
```json
{"routing": [{"match":"seq_len<512","model":"gptx-compact-int8","percent":5},{"match":"seq_len>=512","model":"gptx-base-16b","percent":95}],"fallback":"gptx-base-16b","canary_duration":"24h"}
```
Priya Sen: Concern about renewal messaging — can we put a one-pager for CS explaining expected perf/quality tradeoffs and rollback criteria? Also need sign-off from security for quantized model keys.
Evan Ortiz: I'll draft the CS note. Rollback triggers: >1.5% quality regression on core eval set OR p95 increase >10% for 4h. Also request monitoring hooks: per-route quality alert + cost delta.
ops-bot: Deploy canary policy queued — job id 873322. Notifying infra on schedule.
Maya Patel: Thanks — assigning action items: Evan (customer note + exec summary), Jordan (canary dashboard + perf monitors), Priya (security approval), I'll coordinate customer outreach. 
Jordan Lee: :thumbsup: will set dashboard and add latency/cost/quality panels.
Priya Sen: On it, I'll sync with SecOps by EOD.
Evan Ortiz: ETA for customer note: tomorrow AM, will include sample text and rollback steps. :white_check_mark:
